capabilities: Pan and zoom rendered Mermaid diagrams
Fit diagrams to the frame or reset to 100%
Show table footnote definitions with jump links in full screen
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid editor or renderer; it only adds viewing controls to diagrams and tables that Obsidian already renders.
extras: Table footnote enhancement works only in Reading view, not Live Preview, and the README explains why; BRAT can track pre-release builds. Works on desktop and mobile (Obsidian 1.6.6+).
intentEvidence: Each rendered Mermaid diagram gets an unobtrusive instrument toolbar (it fades in on hover)
problem: Wide Mermaid diagrams and wide tables in Obsidian can only be read through a cramped horizontal scrollbar inside the note's narrow column.
summary: Pan-and-zoom viewer that adds surveying controls to rendered Mermaid diagrams and full-screen viewing for wide diagrams and tables.
